Soo noqnoqodyada dhabta ah ee saddexda tiir waa 46, 52, 44 arday si isku xigta. 
 Qoraalka ogeysiiska: "Ardayda aad u tiro badan ayaa amaahday 5 ama ka badan oo ka yar 10 buug! Waa ku dhowaad laba jeer fasalada kale."

y-m-22-01.goal: Xaqiiji in isla xogta oo la habeeyo balac-fasal kala duwan oo keliya ay ka dhigi karto qaabka qaybinta mid u muuqda mid kala duwan, oo sheeg qaybta xukunkaagii ugu horreeyay ee la ilaalinayo iyo qaybta la saxayo marka miis cusub iyo macluumaad cusub yimaadaan. Dooro balac-fasal soo bandhigid ah, adigoo sabab ku bixinaya.
y-m-22-01.material: 24 arday oo fasal ah ayaa qaadatay imtixaan ereyo ah (100 ka mid ah, dhibcuhu waa tirooyin dhan). Macallinku wuxuu rabaa inuu isla dhibcahaas habeeyo isagoo beddelaya balac-fasalka oo keliya. Dhammaan fasallada waxaa loo akhriyaa 'ugu yaraan ○ dhibcood oo ka yar ○ dhibcood' (tusaale ahaan, '60 dhibcood ama ka badan oo ka yar 80 dhibcood' waxay ku jirtaa 60 dhibcood oo ma ku jirto 80 dhibcood). Magacyo shaqsi lama isticmaalo. Dhibcaha ugu sarreeya waa 98 dhibcood, kuwa ugu hooseeyana waa 47 dhibcood.

y-m-22-06.title: Hababka kala duwan ee loo qaybin karo diiwaannada xadhig-boodiska shan fasal
y-m-22-06.topic: Samaynta shax soo noqnoqod ah: dooridda qiimaha bilowga iyo cabbirka fasallada si ay ugu habboonaadaan shuruudaha
y-m-22-06.goal: Dooro qiimaha bilowga iyo cabbirka fasallada hababka dhowr ah shuruudaha hoostooda ah dhammaan diiwaannadu way ku habboonaadaan, fasal midna madhan ma aha, midna ma buuxdhaafsanayo; si sax ah u maaree xadka ('ka yar'); oo barbar dhig sida qaybintu u eg tahay iyadoo ku xidhan naqshadda.
y-m-22-06.material:
Tirada boodboodka xadhig-boodiska (jeer, tirooyin dhan) ee 16 arday sameeyeen 1 daqiiqo, oo laga bilaabo kan ugu yar loo qoray, waa kuwan.
8, 12, 15, 17, 18, 21, 22, 23, 25, 26, 28, 31, 34, 37, 41, 55
Diiwaannadan waxaa lagu habeeyay shax soo noqnoqod ah. Waxaa jira shan fasal, dhammaantood isku cabbir, oo loo qoray 'ugu yaraan ○ jeer oo ka yar ○ jeer'. Fasalka koowaad wuxuu ka bilaabmaa a jeer ama ka badan, ballaadhka fasalkuna waa w jeer (a waa tiro dabiici ah oo ah 0 ama ka badan, w waa tiro dabiici ah oo ah 1 ama ka badan). Taasi waa, fasallada waxay u socdaan kala horreyn: a ama ka badan oo ka yar a+w, a+w ama ka badan oo ka yar a+2w, … Shuruudaha soo socda waa in la ilaaliyaa. ① Diiwaannada dhammaan 16-ka arday waxay ku dhacaan shanta fasal gudahooda ② Fasal midna madhan ma aha ③ Fasal midna ma laha in ka badan 8 arday (kala bar wadarta).

y-m-22-03.topic: Shaxda xagal-iyo-caleen: wixii shaxda laga odhan karo iyo wixii aan laga odhan karin si hubaal ah

y-m-22-03.material:
Tirada fadhi-kacyada 1 daqiiqo ee 15 arday sameeyeen waxaa lagu muujiyay shax laan-iyo-caleen ah. Laantu waa lambarka tobanaadka caleenta na waa lambarka kelida, '1 | 2' macnaheeduna waa 12 jeer. Caleenaha waxaa lagu qoray laga bilaabo tirada ugu yar.

3 | 1 2 5 6
4 | 0 8
(Marka cod dheer loo akhriyo, saf kasta ayaad akhrisaa, sida 'laanta 1, caleenaha 2, 5, 8', 'laanta 2, caleenaha 0, 1, 3, 4, 4, 7'.)
